text:
maria_g: Quick sync — trying to lock down event naming and SIEM mapping for the RBAC + KMS changes landing next week. Need cross-team signoff on what's customer-visible. pinging telemetry & product.

alex_t: SG. What's the proposed naming pattern?

maria_g: Proposal: dot-delimited hierarchy: service.actor.verb.resource.outcome. Example: `auth.user.grant_role.service_account.success`. Dot format keeps parsing simple for SIEM.

kevin_s: +1 to dots. Two asks: 1) include `schema_version` top-level, 2) include `rbac_policy_v` and `kms_key_alias` when relevant so we can tie events to policy changes.

olga: For customer-facing events we must avoid leaking KMS key material. `kms_key_alias` is fine (customer-facing), never full key id. Also redact internal actor ids unless customer explicitly requested mapping.

ryan_pm: Product-side request: public UI labels should map to internal event types but be stable for docs. Suggest adding `public_label` field in the event payload that we publish to docs/console. That way we can change internal names without breaking customers.

alex_t: SIEM teams asked for `event_category` (e.g., authentication, config_change, key_ops) and `outcome` (success/failure/partial). Example payload we can use as canonical: 

```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.user.grant_role",
  "event_category": "config_change",
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "public_label": "Role granted",
  "actor": { "id": "user:alice", "role": "engineer" },
  "resource": { "type": "service_account", "id": "svc-1234" },
  "rbac_policy_v": "2026-04-01",
  "kms_key_alias": "projects/prod/keys/alias-payments",
  "outcome": "success",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-05T14:12:03Z"
}
```

maria_g: That looks good. Two follow-ups: where do we publish the mapping table? Telemetry needs a machine-readable CSV/JSON and product needs the human-friendly mapping for docs.

audit-bot: Created INF-3421: "event-vocab - SIEM + UI mapping" and added label `eng-security` and `telemetry`.

kevin_s: Migration plan idea: emit both `event_type` (new) and `deprecated_event` (old name) for 3 months. Add a `deprecated_since` timestamp once we stop producing the old name. Also: set a hard rollback plan if customers complain.

olga: Security volunteers to review: maria_g + kevin_s. Telemetry owner? alex_t?

alex_t: I can own telemetry side. Will draft the machine-readable mapping and SIEM example parsers.

maria_g: Great — action items: 1) I will draft Confluence doc with the proposed hierarchy + examples (due EOD Wed), 2) alex_t will produce JSON/CSV mapping (due Thu), 3) kevin_s to produce migration plan and deprecation timeline (due Fri). I'll cc product + compliance for final signoff.

ryan_pm: Thanks all. Once docs are up I'll validate the public_label strings for UX.

alex_t: Thx :thumbsup:
